podcast.body: This song broke into the top 10 on Billboard's Hot 100 during the week ending November 20th, 1982, eventually peaking at number 6. It was characterized as "urban sophisticated." "Steppen Out by Joe Jackson broke into the top 10 on billboards hot 100 on its way to a number 6 peak."

podcast.body: This song was the centerpiece of Joe Jackson's album "Night and Day," a dreamy ode to New York nightlife about a couple making up by going out dancing. Jackson aimed for it to sound like a blend of the 80s and 40s, projecting vintage jazz age New York into the electronic age, embodying his "sophisticated" true self. The music video, filmed at New York's St. Regis Hotel, became an MTV staple, and the single brought Jackson back to the American Top 40, peaking at number 6 on the Hot 100 by December, marking the biggest pop single for any of the "angry young men." "He called the song Step and Out. This was the true Joe Jackson, a so-called punk who'd really been a sophisticated all along."
